Game Overview

In Ruin, the core idea is straightforward: immerse in a tranquil puzzle world where every slide of a block demands precision and strategy. With its calming aesthetics and fluid animations, Ruin challenges your logic through over 100 levels. Gradually increasing difficulty ensures endless mental stimulation, making it perfect for both quick breaks and deep endeavors.
